mutations.name: KB-60 the all-columns public read policy on accounts is back
mutations.sql: create policy "Allow public read of public accounts" on public.accounts for select to anon, authenticated using ((public_profile->>'is_public')::boolean = true);

mutations.name: KB-60 the company page reads accounts again (members only now, so a stranger gets a 404)
mutations.grep: company, project and episode pages render

mutations.name: KB-60 the view exposes the email
mutations.sql: create or replace view public.public_accounts with (security_barrier = true) as select id, name, slug, picture_url, public_profile, updated_at, email from public.accounts where not is_personal_account and coalesce((public_profile->>'is_public')::boolean, false);

mutations.name: KB-60 the view includes public personal accounts
mutations.sql: create or replace view public.public_accounts with (security_barrier = true) as select id, name, slug, picture_url, public_profile, updated_at from public.accounts where coalesce((public_profile->>'is_public')::boolean, false);

mutations.name: KB-60 the view is writable by authenticated
mutations.sql: grant update, delete on public.public_accounts to authenticated;

mutations.name: KB-42 check_account_budget checks nothing again
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.check_account_budget(p_account_id uuid, p_estimated_cost_cents integer default 0) returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $fn$ declare v_current_usage integer; v_budget integer; begin select current_usage_cents, monthly_budget_cents into v_current_usage, v_budget from public.accounts where id = p_account_id; if not found then raise exception 'Account not found: %', p_account_id; end if; if v_budget is null then return true; end if; return (v_current_usage + p_estimated_cost_cents) <= v_budget; end; $fn$;

mutations.name: KB-42 the role comparison is not coalesced (a NULL role lets a stranger through)
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.check_account_budget(p_account_id uuid, p_estimated_cost_cents integer default 0) returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $fn$ declare v_current_usage integer; v_budget integer; begin if not (public.has_account_access(p_account_id) or (select auth.role()) = 'service_role') then return false; end if; select current_usage_cents, monthly_budget_cents into v_current_usage, v_budget from public.accounts where id = p_account_id; if not found then return false; end if; if v_budget is null then return true; end if; return (v_current_usage + p_estimated_cost_cents) <= v_budget; end; $fn$;

mutations.name: KB-42 the service-role branch is dropped
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.check_account_budget(p_account_id uuid, p_estimated_cost_cents integer default 0) returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $fn$ declare v_current_usage integer; v_budget integer; begin if not public.has_account_access(p_account_id) then return false; end if; select current_usage_cents, monthly_budget_cents into v_current_usage, v_budget from public.accounts where id = p_account_id; if not found then return false; end if; if v_budget is null then return true; end if; return (v_current_usage + p_estimated_cost_cents) <= v_budget; end; $fn$;
